'''Yannick Lapointe ISB choke''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-4037">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4037 ISB choke], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 8 March 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/4037/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/4037/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018200602/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4037/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Yannick Lapointe]]
* '''Published:''' 8 March 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''ISB choke''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif|label=ISB Operations}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Arrest Order|Endor-D-imperialarrestorder.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor ISB Lapointe DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits blast the control panel, grabbler: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' this deck flip fast and battle those rebel scum

== Original post ==

'''ISB choke'''
* '''Author:''' Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe
* '''Published:''' March 8, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' this deck flip fast and battle those rebel scum

=== Strategy ===

SORRY I HAVE MAKE AN ERROR ON THE DECK LIST CHANGE DROID SHUTDOWN( light side card ) FOR Shut Em Up or Shut Em Down

the main goal of this deck is to choke your opponent by activating more than him after that flip with your 2 rebel base location and grab as fast as you can imperial decree always start IAO, i know against first turn revo its a bit risky but with your large amount of location you can get decree fast and cancel those revo -against oppget to the farm and put all you can get there after that he will drain for 0 and he will not be able to beatdown you -against HB flip fast for early drain and wait until he flip
